**Please do not report security vulnerabilities through public GitHub issues.**

Instead, use GitHub's private vulnerability reporting:
https://github.com/m00sfett/KeepADB/security/advisories/new

If you can't use that, see [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) for an alternative private channel.

This template exists only to redirect you — submitting it as a public issue will expose the
report to everyone. Please close this and use one of the channels above instead.
